Sidh Automobiles Q2FY27 Results: Net profit turns positive to ₹3.57 lakh Sidh Automobiles reported a net profit of ₹3.57 lakh for Q2FY27, turning around from a loss of ₹0.26 lakh in Q2FY26. Revenue from operations for the quarter was ₹4.32 lakh, compared to nil in the same period last year. Half-year net profit for H1FY27 stood at ₹7.70 lakh, up from ₹1.68 lakh in H1FY26. Total assets increased to ₹668.11 lakh as of September 30, 2026, from ₹659.67 lakh in March 2026. Cash from operations for the half-year was ₹0.06 lakh, with cash balances declining to ₹0.16 lakh
